what: What a design file looks like
title: ResearchDesigns: a library of declared designs
text: starter design two_arm_trial. header optional. minimum need design object (default named design). Parameter tips plain strings params:; quote keys "N" "b". soon file sits inst/designs/, available make_design(), get_args(), get_code(), maintainer audits, run_shiny().
code: --- id: two_arm_trial label: Simple two-arm trial category: template keywords: [experiment, two-arm] description: >   Simple two-arm trial with complete random assignment. params:   "N": "Sample size"   "b": "Treatment effect" include_in_shiny: true ---  N <- 1000 b <- 0.2  design <-      declare_model(     N = N,     potential_outcomes(Y ~ b * Z + rnorm(N))   ) +    declare_inquiry(ATE = mean(Y_Z_1) - mean(Y_Z_0)) +      declare_assignment(Z = complete_ra(N)) +      declare_measurement(Y = reveal_outcomes(Y ~ Z)) +      declare_estimator(Y ~ Z, .method = difference_in_means, inquiry = "ATE")

title: ResearchDesigns: a library of declared designs
text: Call list_designs() see ids, aliases, labels, packages, (discover_params = TRUE) modifiable parameters. Use design_info("two_arm_trial") English profile one design, .data.frame(list_designs()) full table.
code: list_designs(discover_params = FALSE) #> ResearchDesigns library: 6 designs #>  #>  id                  alias label                     #>  pate_with_sampling  4.1   PATE with sampling        #>  two_arm_trial             Simple two-arm trial      #>  two_arm_with_blocks       Two-arm trial with blocks #>  logit_probit_ols    11.5  Logit, probit, or OLS?    #>  two_arm_trial_rdss  2.1   Two-arm trial from RDSS   #>  #> ... and 1 more. #>  #> Packages: logit_probit_ols (margins, broom) #>  #> See design_info("id") or get_args("id") for details; #> as.data.frame(list_designs()) for the full table.

title: ResearchDesigns
text: Point Shiny Server folder. local.R never overwritten re-copy. ## Minimal design file YAML optional. enough: Save inst/designs/my_design.R. Parameters discovered design; redesign() / make_design() use names.
code: remotes::install_github("macartan/ResearchDesigns") ResearchDesigns::install_library_dependencies() ResearchDesigns::copy_library_shiny("/srv/shiny-server/researchdesigns") b <- 0 design <-   declare_model(N = 100, U = rnorm(N), Y_Z_0 = U, Y_Z_1 = U + b) +   declare_inquiry(ATE = mean(Y_Z_1 - Y_Z_0)) +   declare_assignment(Z = complete_ra(N)) +   declare_measurement(Y = Y_Z_1 * Z + Y_Z_0 * (1 - Z)) +   declare_estimator(Y ~ Z, inquiry = "ATE")

title: ResearchDesigns
text: Classic DeclareDesign (DesignLibrary) often paired designer function design: parameters lived designer, tools like expand_design(two_arm_designer, N = c(50, 100)) swept function. Reproducible code glued special extraction ({{{ }}}). DeclareDesignZero keeps declaration verbs (declare_model, +, diagnose_design, …) treats declared design redesignable. Free symbols design (e.g. b, tau) found object, : needs designer DesignLibrary-style gluing. package built model.
code: designs <- redesign(design, tau = c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5)) diagnose_design(designs, sims = 100)
